history: Also called a Muppet or a Slammer depending on the country. The banging is not optional.
whyItWorks: Striking the glass releases the carbonation all at once, so it arrives as foam rather than liquid.
steps: Pour the tequila into a sturdy shot glass and top with soda.
Cover the top with your hand, slam it once on the bar, and drink while it foams.
techniqueNotes: Use a thick-based glass. This breaks thin ones.
name: Tequila Slammer
description: Tequila and lemon-lime soda, slammed to make it foam.
